verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a SaaS remote-desktop service with team accounts, so the axis applies. The evidence never documents choosing a storage region or residency location. The peer-to-peer routing claim and the in-firewall Enterprise relay are adjacent network-path controls, not a data-residency selection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
